## Hacegaba Confirmed as Port of Long Beach CEO

The Long Beach Board of Harbor Commissioners on Monday unanimously appointed Dr. Noel Hacegaba as the incoming Chief Executive Officer of the Port of Long Beach, effective Jan. 1, 2026. [Read More](https://polb.com/port-info/news-and-press/hacegaba-confirmed-as-port-of-long-beach-ceo-12-09-2025/)
